newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Phoenix Central School District, N.Y., $2.99 million school general obligation bonds.
--Rensselaer Central School District, N.Y., $8.05 million school district GOs.
--Longview, Texas, $8 million tax and revenue bonds.
--Greenbrier County Board of Education, W.Va., $8 million school bonds.
